SafeMigrations — EF Core 8, 9 and 10 / SQL Server migration safety checks

safemigrations check --assembly <path.dll> [options]

  --provider SqlServer       Only supported provider (default: SqlServer)
  --context <name>           DbContext name or fully qualified name
  --ignore-before <id>       Skip migration IDs strictly before this ID (ordinal)
  --fail-on error|warning|info  Minimum severity for exit 1 (default: error)
  --format console|json      Output format (default: console)
  --help                     Show this help

Exit codes: 0 = no findings at threshold; 1 = threshold reached; 2 = inspection/usage failure.
Build the migrations project first. Only inspect trusted assemblies: constructors and Up()
execute in this process. The tool does not apply generated operations or connect to a database.
Only six rules are checked; a clean result is not proof of migration safety.
